HISTORICAL CALIBRATION · Compare past predictions with official results

Uses the same performance scoring equation as the live batch simulator against archived races without exposing the finish order to the simulated outcomes, then jointly fits morning-line prior strength and horse-ability influence against winners and top-three finishes. Calibration is applied only when explicitly enabled and when complete starter lists are available. Otherwise, run diagnostics without changing the original model. Only races with embedded, name-matched results are used. Archive verification requires matching official starters; unmatched races are excluded, not guessed.

Historical-only calibration: ONLY races with uploaded official results and matching pre-race BRIS cards are considered. Unresulted cards and the currently selected race are ignored. Verified scratches are removed; parameters are fitted on earlier resulted dates and tested on later resulted dates. Approved settings are then used by the normal simulator.

HISTORICAL CALIBRATION MODE — Official archived results are used only to evaluate past races. Original weights remain active: prior 0.55, ability 0.85. Calibration requires uploaded results, a matching BRIS card, verified starters, and a complete top-three finish. Unresulted race cards are never training inputs.

Important: this is a limited calibration, not proof of profitable wagering. The embedded historical data now includes verified starter/scratch lists for the eight Oct 14 races, but does not yet include every race's complete finish order, payouts, or confirmed scratches. For scratch-correct backtests, add official starter lists or explicit scratched-horse lists to the archive.

RACE DYNAMICS LAB Optional experimental engine

Simulate START → EARLY → MIDDLE → FINISH with variable breaks, post-dependent trip risk, traffic, early-pace competition, and fatigue. This separate experimental engine supports up to 1,000,000 trials and does not modify the original race animation.

Ready. Results are experimental and not calibrated probabilities.

Worker-based computation where available, with asynchronous fallback for browsers that block local Blob workers. Counts are frequencies of ordered finishes, not wagering payouts. Trip and fatigue assumptions are heuristic.

Runs archived races using pre-race BRIS cards, evaluates top-five exactas and trifectas, then scores predictions against their recorded winners. Choose the original, saved calibrated, or both models. This diagnostic never changes calibration settings. The export includes horse-level win probabilities and data-quality flags for review.

Up to 1 million simulations per race per model · Runs in responsive batches · Read-only
Ready. Test only completed races with verified results; calibration settings will not change.

The report is diagnostic, not an independent validation of tuned weights. Results lacking a complete verified starter list are flagged and excluded from aggregate metrics. This does not simulate or score payouts.

EXPLORATORY PROTOTYPE
Simulated win rates and exactas are generated by a synthetic race model seeded with morning-line odds. They are not validated win probabilities, fair odds, or positive-value betting recommendations.

Ready.

Ratings reflect available historical DRF fields. Missing values are excluded, never treated as zero. Scores are heuristic and not validated win probabilities.

Automatically decodes the BRIS pace/speed fields in a compatible imported 1,435-field DRF. Nothing is manually entered. Derived metrics are analytical aids, not BRIS proprietary scores. Bundled sample cards may not include historical pace figures; import the matching DRF to populate them.
